body.def: \(\mathsf{VPA}\) dovetails conforming rational refinement, exact-moment rational-nodal primal witnesses, unrestricted rational multipliers, rational atomic partial-transport plans, and outward rational interval arithmetic until the requested endpoint gap is certified.
body.role: Produces exact primal witnesses and outward endpoint enclosures on rational geometry at relative-interior means.
